pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (mean abs change of sky rows between consecutive frames <= 0.5 grey levels; no pan/shake)
camera.focal_length: unknown - estimate from a question's depth_info + known size

perspective_cues.far_shoreline_y_px: about 630-632, nearly horizontal across the image (water/sand boundary); true horizon is hidden behind the dunes, so it lies above y = 630
perspective_cues.ground_plane: flat water surface filling y > ~632; the boat waterline moves from y 679 to y 684 (lower in the image = nearer the camera)

objects.name: boat
objects.description: red and white fishing boat (red hull with white top band and a lettered name, white cabin with a red roof, white rails at the stern, a thin white mast with a short black antenna/light bar). Bow points left, slightly toward the camera; we see its port side
objects.reference_point: the origin cannot be seen. Candidates: hull_bbox_cx/cy (centre of the red-hull box: x between bow and stern, y between hull top and waterline) or mask_cx/cy (centroid of the whole visible boat above the waterline). They give the same horizontal motion (~2.63 px/frame); hull_bbox_cy is about 7 px lower than mask_cy
objects.apparent_size_change: length grows linearly about 156.7 + 0.26*frame px (x1.11 over the clip); height (waterline to mast top) 188.5 -> 200.5 px (x1.06). The boat gets slightly nearer the camera while it moves left
objects.notes: length_px_hull = red-hull extent bow to stern (best length measure, +/-2 px); length_px_mask (whole silhouette) jitters by +/-6 px because water ripples at the bow leak into the mask. The length seen is along the image x axis; the boat is turned slightly toward the camera, so its true length is foreshortened a little. Width (beam) is not measurable from this view.

objects.name: bird
objects.description: small dark bird (gull-like silhouette, black) flapping across the sky just above the dunes, left to right
objects.visible_frames: 0-74 (all). Frames 48-49: overlaps the boat's antenna in the image (passes in front of it); centre is interpolated there (cx_interp/cy_interp, occluded=1)
objects.reference_point: centroid of the dark silhouette (cx, cy); bbox centre is also given
objects.image_motion: about 7.3 px/frame to the right (cx linear fit 55.2 + 7.28*frame; first frames are a bit slower). y goes up and down between 518 and 538 (wavy flight)
objects.size_px: wingspan changes with the wingbeat: bbox width 13-28 px (median 19), height 4-20 px (median 11); widest when the wings are spread flat (e.g. frames 30, 54: 25 and 23 px wide, 4-12 px tall)
objects.notes: small object (~100 px area): bbox +/-1-2 px. Its depth is unknown and need not equal the boat's.

objects.name: shore_posts
objects.description: small group of dark brown wooden posts/stumps at the water's edge on the left shore
objects.notes: a lighter, low structure goes on to its left (x ~ 92-110) and there is a tiny dark speck at (109, 642); the edges are soft

objects.name: left_beach
objects.description: pale sandy beach/spit in the left foreground, sloping down from the left image edge to the water (x 0-~250, y ~600-720)

objects.name: sand_dunes
objects.description: range of sand-coloured dunes/hills behind the water on the far shore across the full width; ridge y by x given under camera.perspective_cues

objects.name: water
objects.description: rippling sea/lake surface from the far shoreline y~631 to the bottom of the frame; shows the boat's red reflection under the hull

objects.name: far_right_specks
objects.description: a few tiny dark specks on the dune ridge at x ~ 925-945, y ~ 558-562 (possibly distant posts/birds); static, too small to measure
